name: Module private authorization belongs only to one composition edge revision

input.fixture_ref: Grant one host edge private access, compare another host and closed Module instance, remove the edge, then re-include without private authorization.

applicability.reason: Requires composition-edge private authorization metadata. Module method visibility IS enforced, a private Module method answers MethodVisibilityError, but the row asserts that only the GRANTED edge revision may call it and that removal revokes atomically; there is no per-edge grant state or revision inspection to observe either half.

expect.status: Only the granted edge revision can call the private selector; removal revokes it atomically and re-inclusion does not inherit the old grant.
